#!/bin/bash
SUPABASE_URL="https://tdjtumtdkjicnhlpqqzd.supabase.co"
ANON_KEY="eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6InRkanR1bXRka2ppY25obHBxcXpkIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3NjExNzIxNzMsImV4cCI6MjA3Njc0ODE3M30.jwQgnjHjz2v2w9-mKVKMy8mT8Q9VgknxFammzW4V9ng"

# Unique book/chapter combinations to regenerate
declare -a ITEMS=\(
  "Genesis:0:book"
  "Genesis:1:chapter"
  "Genesis:15:chapter"
  "Daniel:2:chapter"
  "Daniel:5:chapter"
  "Isaiah:0:book"
  "Isaiah:1:chapter"
  "Isaiah:2:chapter"
  "Ezekiel:1:chapter"
  "John:1:chapter"
  "John:2:chapter"
  "John:3:chapter"
  "John:4:chapter"
  "Colossians:1:chapter"
  "Colossians:5:chapter"
  "Psalms:23:chapter"
  "Revelation:21:chapter"
  "Revelation:22:chapter"
\)

TOTAL=${#ITEMS[@]}
COUNT=0

for item in "${ITEMS[@]}"; do
  IFS=':' read -r BOOK CHAPTER SCOPE <<< "$item"
  COUNT=$\(\(COUNT + 1\)\)
  echo "[$COUNT/$TOTAL] Regenerating $BOOK $CHAPTER \($SCOPE\)..."
  
  if [ "$SCOPE" = "book" ]; then
    BODY="{\\"book\\": \\"$BOOK\\", \\"scope\\": \\"book\\", \\"regenerate\\": true}"
  else
    BODY="{\\"book\\": \\"$BOOK\\", \\"chapter\\": $CHAPTER, \\"regenerate\\": true}"
  fi
  
  RESULT=$\(curl -s -X POST "${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/generate-epic-commentary" \\
    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ANON_KEY}" \\
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
    -d "$BODY" --max-time 600\)
  
  echo "  Result: $RESULT"
  echo ""
done

echo "=== ALL DONE ==="
SCRIPT)

  "Jonah:4" "Micah:7" "Nahum:3" "Habakkuk:3" "Zephaniah:3"
  "Haggai:2" "Zechariah:14" "Malachi:4"
  "Matthew:28" "Mark:16" "Luke:24" "John:21"
  "Acts:28" "Romans:16" "1 Corinthians:16" "2 Corinthians:13"
  "Galatians:6" "Ephesians:6" "Philippians:4" "Colossians:4"
  "1 Thessalonians:5" "2 Thessalonians:3" "1 Timothy:6" "2 Timothy:4"
  "Titus:3" "Philemon:1" "Hebrews:13" "James:5"
  "1 Peter:5" "2 Peter:3" "1 John:5" "2 John:1" "3 John:1"
  "Jude:1" "Revelation:22"
\)

TOTAL=0
for entry in "${BOOKS[@]}"; do
  IFS=':' read -r BOOK CHAPTERS <<< "$entry"
  TOTAL=$\(\(TOTAL + CHAPTERS\)\)
done

COUNT=0
ERRORS=0
echo "=== Starting full Bible Epic regeneration: $TOTAL chapters ==="
echo "Started at: $\(date\)"
echo ""

for entry in "${BOOKS[@]}"; do
  IFS=':' read -r BOOK CHAPTERS <<< "$entry"
  
  for CH in $\(seq 1 $CHAPTERS\); do
    COUNT=$\(\(COUNT + 1\)\)
    echo "[$COUNT/$TOTAL] $BOOK $CH ..."
    
    RESULT=$\(curl -s -X POST "${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/generate-epic-commentary" \\
      -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ANON_KEY}" \\
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
      -d "{\\"book\\": \\"$BOOK\\", \\"chapter\\": $CH, \\"regenerate\\": true}" \\
      --max-time 600 2>&1\)
    
    STATUS=$\(echo "$RESULT" | grep -o '"status":"[^"]*"' | head -1\)
    
    if echo "$RESULT" | grep -q '"status":"ready"'; then
      echo "  OK \($STATUS\)"
    elif echo "$RESULT" | grep -q '"status":"already_exists"'; then
      echo "  OK \(regenerated\)"
    else
      ERRORS=$\(\(ERRORS + 1\)\)
      echo "  ERROR: $RESULT"
    fi
    
    # Brief pause between calls
    sleep 2
  done
done

echo ""
echo "=== COMPLETE ==="
echo "Finished at: $\(date\)"
echo "Total: $COUNT chapters, $ERRORS errors"
SCRIPT)
